 Bitcoin traded below $70,000 for the first time since August in a risk-off move, falling as low as $67,632.68, its lowest level since Aug. 19, according to Coin Metrics. CNBC’s MacKenzie Sigalos has the details. 01:46 Fri, Nov 13 2026 5:45 PM EST
